newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia PM to meet head of Chechen rebel government.
newsitem.headline: Russia PM to meet head of Chechen rebel government.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin will meet the head of the Chechen rebel government Aslan Maskhadov in Moscow on Saturday, a spokesman for the premier said.

He said the meeting would be closed to the press and did not give any details. Earlier Russian media reports said the two men were expected to sign a new deal on a peace settlement in the breakaway Russian territory.

Earlier on Saturday Yeltsin ordered the withdrawal of two remaining Russian brigades from Chechnya to facilitate a peace settlement in the breakaway Russian region and the holding of elections there, the Kremlin press service said.

Most Russian troops have already left Chechnya, scene of 21 months of fierce fighting in which tens of thousands died. Moscow had wanted the two brigades to stay in Chechnya on a permanent basis but rebels insisted all Russian troops leave.

Russian media reports said the accord, due to be signed by Chernomyrdin and Maskhadov mainly covered reconstruction of the region and also included guarantees for tens of thousands of Russians caught up in the fighting that ended with a peace accord signed on August 31.

Despite the progress of their talks, a permanent political settlement remains elusive, with the Chechen side insisting on full independence and Moscow trying to keep the region within the Russian Federation.
